embeddingDomain.notes: Distance from a query molecule's D-MPNN pooled embedding to its nearest training-set centroid. inDomain/borderline thresholds are the 90th/99th percentile of this same nearest-centroid distance computed self-consistently over the training set itself (so ~90% of training molecules fall inDomain by construction) -- a heuristic applicability-domain signal, not a calibrated statistical confidence interval. See compute_applicability_domain.py's module docstring for why conformal calibration isn't attempted here.
